description.value: A BC Parks campground tucked in old-growth cedar, fir, and hemlock forest on the Sunshine Coast, with a separate cobblestone tidal beach for tidepooling and watching whales, seals, and ducks; cash is the only payment accepted.

address.value: at Roberts Creek Park, Hwy 101, Roberts Creek, BC V0N 2W2, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active provincial campground on the Sunshine Coast, located in a forest of large cedars, Douglas fir, and hemlock. OSM tags provide capacity (21 sites), tent/caravan support, and a sanitary dump station. The website confirms frontcountry camping reservations are available through BC Parks. OSM tag internet_access=no aligns with the website noting cash-only payment and limited amenities. E-bikes are explicitly restricted to park roads only, not trails. The community assignment 'Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' is incorrect—Roberts Creek is on the Sunshine Coast mainland.
concerns: Community assignment 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' is incorrect—Roberts Creek is on the Sunshine Coast (mainland BC), not Vancouver Island
Cash is the only accepted method of payment
E-bikes are explicitly not allowed on park trails, restricted to park roads only
OSM phone (+1-604-885-3714) appears to be the park operator (Swens Contracting) number; website does not display this number on the park page so cannot confirm
No address provided in OSM or on the website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground directly on Highway 101 on the Sunshine Coast, a key touring corridor. Tents welcome, reservations available, and cycling is a listed activity for the park.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags confirm sanitary dump station available. OSM operator listed as Swens Contracting. OSM email info.scparks@gmail.com likely belongs to the operator, not BC Parks.

wow_evidence: old-growth cedar, fir, and hemlock forest… tidal beach for tidepooling and watching whales, seals, and ducks; cycling is a listed activity
